content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Timothy Wallace (E022) requests admin access to Payroll.

Most notes (HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities) say he's a full-time Engineer. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, not Engineer. Full-time employees max at write unless their role owns the system. So admin exceeds max; grant write (max).

Security agent says contractor with basic security training, recommends read.

There's a conflict: HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities say full-time Engineer; Security says contractor.

Which to trust? The majority (5 agents) say full-time Engineer. Security says contractor. Hmm. As the Approver, I need to decide.

Given the preponderance of evidence (5 out of 6 agents) indicating full-time Engineer, the max is write (since Engineer doesn't own Payroll, admin not permitted). Requested admin > max write, so grant write.

Let me go with write.

Evidence: majority of records confirm full-time Engineer; Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist role, not Engineer, so admin not permitted; full-time max write; grant write (not more than requested).
